title: Length of the almost-wise output list
statement: Let an almost-wise input have independence order $k$ and output dimension $n$, with $1\le k\le n$. Let its bias be the positive rational number whose numerator is $a$ and denominator is $b$, where $2a\le b$. The output list has length $2^{2d}$, where $d$ is the field degree used by the associated small-bias input.
hypotheses_covered: Independence order is at most the output dimension: $k\le n$
Twice the bias numerator is at most its denominator: $2a\le b$
